name: @treaty/module-federation
description: Automatic, zero-config Module Federation for Treaty apps. Generates a normalized federation config (host + remotes, @angular/* shared singletons) from project structure / simple options, plus adapters that turn it into plugin-ready options for @module-federation/enhanced (Rspack/webpack) and @module-federation/vite (Vite). Every Treaty app is a Module Federation host automatically — the developer configures nothing.
author: Jordan Hall
